font-family:'PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC','Microsoft YaHei','Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif;font-size:13px

svg.text: Without memory, agents forget your preferences and re-learn every task. Memory comes in

text.style: font-family:'PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC','Microsoft YaHei','Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif;font-size:13px

svg.text: four types (working, episodic, semantic, procedural) and four design patterns (skill

text.style: font-family:'PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC','Microsoft YaHei','Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif;font-size:13px

svg.text: libraries, tiers, reflection, maintenance). The open problems are what to forget and how

text.style: font-family:'PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC','Microsoft YaHei','Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif;font-size:13px

svg.text: to keep memory private and safe.

text.style: font-family:'PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC','Microsoft YaHei','Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif;font-size:13px

svg.text: 没有记忆，智能体会忘记你的偏好，每个任务都要重学。记忆分四类（工作、情景、语义、程序），有

text.style: font-family:'PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC','Microsoft YaHei','Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif;font-size:13px

svg.text: 四种设计模式（技能库、分层、反思、维护）。尚未解决的问题是：该忘掉什么，以及如何保证记忆的

text.style: font-family:'PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC','Microsoft YaHei','Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif;font-size:13px
